description: Matrix protocol behavior settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.MatrixConfig.

message_status_events.description: Send message status events (MSC3381) for bridge message processing.

delivery_receipts.description: Send delivery receipts after successfully bridging a message.

message_error_notices.description: Send error notices to the room when a message fails to bridge.

sync_direct_chat_list.description: Sync the m.direct account data event with bridged DM rooms.

upload_file_threshold.description: Maximum file size in bytes to upload directly (default 5 MiB).

ghost_extra_profile_info.description: Set extra profile info (e.g. identifiers) on ghost users.
